messages:
sara-support: FYI customer is hitting partial output on SSE chat. They get initial tokens, then ~8s of silence, then only the trailing close chunk arrives. UI ends up hung waiting for final tokens. customer request_id=rid_0a1b2c3d, attached curl and minimal repro in their message.

miguel-eng: can you paste the exact curl they used and the client environment (browser/node/nginx/cdn)? also confirm whether they used websockets or SSE.

sara-support: pasted from customer: ```curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \"https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/stream?model=gpt-rc\" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}],"stream":true}' -N``` They say nginx reverse proxy + Cloudflare in front of their app, browser consumer. They attached a short HAR and console logs.

miguel-eng: thanks. common causes: proxy buffering (nginx proxy_buffer, cloudflare buffering), or our ingress chunk coalescing when content-length missing. ask customer to reproduce without proxies (direct to API) and with curl --no-buffer -N. also ask them to try websocat/websocket if they can.

ali-devex: suggested repro curl to give customer: ```curl -v --no-buffer -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" -H \"X-Debug-Request: rid_0a1b2c3d\" \"https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/stream?model=gpt-rc\" -d @payload.json``` note: payload.json contains streaming body. Ask them to include --raw and capture tcpdump if possible.

ryan-ml: from infra side we should check ingress traces for rid_0a1b2c3d (router + lb + api-gateway). check whether Transfer-Encoding: chunked is preserved from upstream -> backend, and whether there are any 502/timeout hints. Also check our streamer logs for final 'end-of-stream' event and KV flush ordering.

sara-support: customer tried direct to api (bypassing nginx) and still saw ~3s silence before final chunk, smaller gap but still reproducible. They uploaded debug bundle: https://s3.redwood-internal/support/rid_0a1b2c3d-debug.zip (permission granted for support).

miguel-eng: grabbing the bundle now. quick checks: client closed events? any socket resets? also check if browser is coalescing small chunks — some browsers buffer until newline. ask customer to append an extra newline after each SSE \"data:\" frame as a test.

ali-devex: repro steps to ask customer to run and attach outputs: 1) curl --no-buffer (above) 2) node repro using native fetch in a small script printing chunks 3) tcpdump -w capture.pcap port 443 (if they can) 4) browser HAR + console with network.stream response. Provide exact headers to include: Authorization, X-Request-Id (their rid), X-Debug-Request.

ryan-ml: on our side I pulled logs for rid_0a1b2c3d: ingress shows consistent streaming with small chunk flushes, final 'EOS' emitted by streamer at t+1.2s. But gateway shows a gap before sending the last HTTP chunk to the client — looks like the connection to client was still open and we had data buffered in gateway for ~3s. suspect cloudflare or client-side buffering.

sara-support: shared that customer uses Cloudflare 'Argo' and has 'response buffering' on by default. they toggled to bypass and gap went away. they said disabling CF + direct test resolved issue.

miguel-eng: that confirms it's likely intermediate buffering. still want to capture exact bytes to be certain (are we sending proper event delimiters like \"\\n\\n\" after each SSE). if we detect repeated reports we can add explicit chunk-flush knobs or SSE keepalive pings.

ali-devex: next actions for support: 1) advise customer to disable CF buffering or enable 'Origin Pull Chunked Transfer' where applicable 2) ask them to run the curl --no-buffer test and attach stdout 3) close the loop with docs snippet on SSE best-practices + headers to set (Transfer-Encoding: chunked, Connection: keep-alive). I'll draft a short KB.

deploy-bot: deploy noticed: streaming-router v3.4.1 rolled at 2026-03-10 03:12 UTC — no rollbacks.

ryan-ml: we'll also add a quick metric to detect >2s gaps between streamer 'token' events and last-client-send per request so we can alert on buffering incidents. raising a small ticket for infra.

sara-support: customer verified KB steps fixed their app when they disabled CF buffering. sending them the KB + repro commands and marking as working-for-now. I'll keep thread open for infra follow-up. :thumbsup:

miguel-eng: thanks — please paste the customer's final confirmation here and link to the debug bundle for records. once infra flag is in, we can proactively message other customers using CF.

sara-support: pasted their final note: \"we disabled Cloudflare response buffering and streaming is smooth now. thanks!\" attaching debug bundle link above. closing for support but keeping infra ticket linked.
_meta: do not include any additional nested objects; messages field is a single continuous thread string
